record.original_question: Let sigma be a continuous Borel measure on the unit circle, and let T be an ergodic Gaussian automorphism whose spectrum contains sigma as a component; when sigma is singular, such a Gaussian automorphism has zero entropy. Do zero-entropy ergodic Gaussian automorphisms satisfy all of the properties S_n, where S_n means that every n-fold self-joining whose projections to all (n - 1)-dimensional faces equal mu^{n-1} is trivial?

evidence.quote: Говорим, что действие Ψ принадлежит классу S(m, n), n > m > 1 (или обладает свойством S(m, n)), если всякое cамоприсоединение порядка n > 2 такое, что все проекции на m-мерные грани куба X^n равны µ^m, является тривиальным, т.е. совпадает с мерой µ^n, произведением n копий меры µ. Далее используем обозначение S_n = S(n − 1, n), n > 2.

Для любой непрерывной борелевской меры σ на единичной окружности в комплексной плоскости найдется эргодический гауссовский автоморфизм, спектр которого содержит σ в качестве компоненты. Если же мера σ сингулярна, то соответствующий гауссовский автоморфизм имеет нулевую энтропию.
Q11. Обладают ли свойствами S_n эргодические гауссовские автоморфизмы с нулевой энтропией ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a standard probability space and let $T:X\to X$ be an invertible measure-preserving ergodic transformation. For integers $n>m>1$, say that $T$ has property $S(m,n)$ if every self-joining of order $n$ of $T$ — i.e., every $T^{\times n}$-invariant probability measure $\nu$ on $X^n$ with all one-dimensional marginals equal to $\mu$ — that has the additional property that all of its projections onto every $m$-dimensional coordinate face of $X^n$ coincide with the product measure $\mu^{\otimes m}$, must itself equal the product measure $\mu^{\otimes n}$. Set $S_n := S(n-1,n)$ for $n\ge 2$.

Recall that a Gaussian automorphism is the measure-preserving transformation associated to a stationary real Gaussian process $(\xi_k)_{k\in\mathbb{Z}}$ via the shift; its maximal spectral type on the orthocomplement of constants is determined by a symmetric finite Borel measure $\sigma$ on the unit circle $\mathbb{T}\subset\mathbb{C}$ (the spectral measure of the process). For every continuous Borel measure $\sigma$ on $\mathbb{T}$ there exists an ergodic Gaussian automorphism whose reduced spectral type contains $\sigma$ as a component; if $\sigma$ is singular with respect to Lebesgue measure, then the corresponding Gaussian automorphism has zero Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy.

Question: Does every ergodic Gaussian automorphism with zero entropy possess property $S_n$ for all integers $n\ge 2$?
artifact.status_search_result: The search did not surface a published resolution of whether all zero-entropy ergodic Gaussian automorphisms satisfy the joining properties $S_n = S(n-1,n)$. Recent works by Ryzhikov and collaborators (2024) on Gaussian/Poisson suspensions, joinings, and spectral properties continue to pose related questions (e.g. PID for zero-entropy Gaussian/Poisson systems with various spectral types), suggesting the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Spectra and joint dynamics of Poisson suspensions
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Gaussian and Poisson suspensions with singular spectrum and zero entropy and open questions on joining properties.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2024) work continues to study joining-type properties of zero-entropy Gaussian systems, indicating these S_n questions remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Spectral theory of dynamical systems (Kanigowski–Lemańczyk survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing self-joinings and spectral properties of Gaussian automorphisms without resolving the S_n property for all zero-entropy Gaussian systems.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of S_n for all zero-entropy ergodic Gaussian automorphisms is recorded in the survey literature.
